source.text: Λαλούντων δὲ αὐτῶν πρὸς τὸν λαὸν ἐπέστησαν αὐτοῖς οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ ὁ στρατηγὸς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ οἱ Σαδδουκαῖοι, διαπονούμενοι διὰ τὸ διδάσκειν αὐτοὺς τὸν λαὸν καὶ καταγγέλλειν ἐν τῷ Ἰησοῦ τὴν ἀνάστασιν τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν, καὶ ἐπέβαλον αὐτοῖς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ ἔθεντο εἰς τήρησιν εἰς τὴν αὔριον, ἦν γὰρ ἑσπέρα ἤδη.

records.literal_gloss: Speaking now of them to the people came upon them the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees, \v 2 being greatly annoyed because of the to teach them the people and to proclaim in the Jesus the resurrection the from [the] dead, \v 3 and they laid on them the hands and put [them] into custody until the next day; it was for evening already.

en.L: And while they were speaking to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came upon them, \v 2 being greatly annoyed because they were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection from [the] dead. \v 3 And they laid hands on them and put [them] in custody until the next day, for it was already evening.
en.B: Peter and John were still speaking to the people when the priests, the commander of the temple guard and the Sadducees confronted them. \v 2 These men were deeply irritated that the apostles were teaching the people and declaring that in Jesus there is resurrection from the dead. \v 3 They took hold of them and, because evening had already come, kept them under guard until the next day.
en.R: Peter and John were still talking to the people when some priests came up to them. The captain of the temple guards and some Sadducees came too. \v 2 They were very angry, because the apostles were teaching the people that because of Jesus, dead people will rise to life again. \v 3 So they grabbed Peter and John. It was already evening, so they put them in jail until the next day.

fr.L: Et pendant qu’ils parlaient au peuple, les prêtres, le commandant du temple et les Sadducéens survinrent auprès d’eux, \v 2 profondément irrités de ce qu’ils enseignaient le peuple et annonçaient en Jésus la résurrection d’entre les morts. \v 3 Et ils mirent les mains sur eux et [les] placèrent sous garde jusqu’au lendemain, car c’était déjà le soir.
fr.B: Pierre et Jean parlaient encore au peuple quand les prêtres, le chef de la garde du temple et les Sadducéens se présentèrent devant eux. \v 2 Ces hommes étaient profondément irrités de voir les apôtres enseigner le peuple et proclamer qu’en Jésus il y a la résurrection des morts. \v 3 Ils se saisirent d’eux et, comme le soir était déjà venu, les gardèrent sous surveillance jusqu’au lendemain.
fr.R: Pierre et Jean parlaient encore aux gens quand des prêtres sont venus vers eux. Le chef des gardes du temple et des Sadducéens sont venus aussi. \v 2 Ils étaient très en colère, parce que les apôtres enseignaient au peuple que, grâce à Jésus, les morts vont revenir à la vie. \v 3 Ils ont donc arrêté Pierre et Jean. C’était déjà le soir, alors ils les ont mis en prison jusqu’au lendemain.

sw.L: Na walipokuwa wakisema na watu, makuhani na mkuu wa [walinzi wa] hekalu na Masadukayo wakawajia, \v 2 wakiwa wamechukizwa sana kwa sababu walikuwa wakiwafundisha watu na kutangaza katika Yesu ufufuo kutoka kwa wafu. \v 3 Wakawatia mikono, wakawaweka chini ya ulinzi hadi kesho yake, kwa kuwa ilikuwa tayari jioni.
sw.B: Petro na Yohana walikuwa bado wakizungumza na watu, makuhani, mkuu wa walinzi wa hekalu na Masadukayo walipowajia. \v 2 Watu hao walikasirishwa sana kwa sababu mitume walikuwa wakiwafundisha watu na kutangaza kwamba katika Yesu kuna ufufuo wa wafu. \v 3 Wakawakamata, na kwa kuwa ilikuwa tayari jioni, wakawaweka chini ya ulinzi hadi kesho yake.
sw.R: Petro na Yohana walikuwa bado wakizungumza na watu, makuhani fulani walipowajia. Mkuu wa walinzi wa hekalu na baadhi ya Masadukayo walikuja pia. \v 2 Walikasirika sana, kwa sababu mitume walikuwa wakiwafundisha watu kwamba, kwa sababu ya Yesu, watu waliokufa watafufuka tena. \v 3 Kwa hiyo wakawakamata Petro na Yohana. Ilikuwa tayari jioni, kwa hiyo wakawatia gerezani hadi kesho yake.

es.L: Y mientras ellos hablaban al pueblo, se les presentaron los sacerdotes, el capitán del templo y los saduceos, \v 2 muy molestos porque ellos enseñaban al pueblo y anunciaban en Jesús la resurrección de entre [los] muertos. \v 3 Y les echaron mano y [los] pusieron bajo custodia hasta el día siguiente, porque ya era el atardecer.
es.B: Pedro y Juan seguían hablando al pueblo cuando se les enfrentaron los sacerdotes, el capitán del templo y los saduceos. \v 2 Estaban muy irritados porque los apóstoles enseñaban al pueblo y anunciaban que en Jesús hay resurrección de los muertos. \v 3 Los arrestaron y, como ya anochecía, los dejaron bajo custodia hasta el día siguiente.
es.R: Pedro y Juan todavía estaban hablando a la gente cuando llegaron algunos sacerdotes. También vinieron el jefe de la guardia del templo y algunos saduceos. \v 2 Estaban muy enojados, porque los apóstoles enseñaban a la gente que, gracias a Jesús, los muertos volverán a la vida. \v 3 Así que arrestaron a Pedro y a Juan. Como ya era de noche, los metieron en la cárcel hasta el día siguiente.

vi.L: Trong khi họ đang nói với dân chúng, các thầy tế lễ, viên chỉ huy đền thờ và những người Sa-đu-sê đến gặp họ, \v 2 vô cùng bực tức vì họ dạy dân chúng và rao giảng trong Đức Giê-xu sự sống lại từ cõi chết. \v 3 Họ tra tay bắt hai ông và giam giữ cho đến hôm sau, vì trời đã tối rồi.
vi.B: Phi-e-rơ và Giăng còn đang nói với dân chúng thì các thầy tế lễ, viên chỉ huy lính canh đền thờ và những người Sa-đu-sê kéo đến. \v 2 Những người này rất bực tức vì các sứ đồ dạy dân chúng và rao giảng rằng trong Đức Giê-xu có sự sống lại từ cõi chết. \v 3 Họ bắt hai ông, và vì trời đã tối nên họ giam giữ hai ông cho đến hôm sau.
vi.R: Phi-e-rơ và Giăng vẫn còn đang nói với dân chúng thì có mấy thầy tế lễ đến. Viên chỉ huy lính canh đền thờ và mấy người Sa-đu-sê cũng đến. \v 2 Họ rất tức giận, vì các sứ đồ dạy dân chúng rằng nhờ Đức Giê-xu, người chết sẽ sống lại. \v 3 Vậy họ bắt Phi-e-rơ và Giăng. Lúc ấy trời đã tối, nên họ nhốt hai ông vào tù cho đến hôm sau.

ko.L: 그런데 그들이 백성에게 말하고 있을 때, 제사장들과 성전 경비대장과 사두개파 사람들이 그들에게 들이닥쳤다. \v 2 그들은 사도들이 백성을 가르치고 예수 안에서 죽은 사람들의 부활을 선포하는 것 때문에 몹시 불쾌해했다. \v 3 그래서 그들에게 손을 대어 다음 날까지 가두어 두었다. 이미 저녁이었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 베드로와 요한이 아직 백성에게 말하고 있는데, 제사장들과 성전 경비대장과 사두개파 사람들이 그들에게 다가왔다. \v 2 그들은 사도들이 백성을 가르치며, 예수 안에서 죽은 사람들이 부활한다고 전하는 것 때문에 몹시 언짢아했다. \v 3 그들은 사도들을 붙잡았으나, 이미 저녁이 되었으므로 다음 날까지 가두어 두었다.
ko.R: 베드로와 요한이 아직 사람들에게 이야기하고 있는데, 제사장 몇 사람이 그들에게 다가왔다. 성전 경비대장과 사두개파 사람들도 함께 왔다. \v 2 그들은 몹시 화가 나 있었다. 사도들이 사람들에게, 예수 덕분에 죽은 사람들이 다시 살아날 것이라고 가르쳤기 때문이다. \v 3 그래서 그들은 베드로와 요한을 붙잡았다. 이미 저녁이었으므로, 그들은 두 사람을 다음 날까지 감옥에 가두었다.

pt.L: E, enquanto eles falavam ao povo, vieram sobre eles os sacerdotes e o capitão do templo e os saduceus, \v 2 muito irritados porque eles ensinavam o povo e anunciavam em Jesus a ressurreição dentre [os] mortos. \v 3 E lançaram as mãos sobre eles e [os] puseram sob custódia até o dia seguinte, pois já anoitecia.
pt.B: Pedro e João ainda estavam falando ao povo quando os sacerdotes, o comandante da guarda do templo e os saduceus os abordaram. \v 2 Esses homens estavam profundamente irritados porque os apóstolos ensinavam o povo e anunciavam que em Jesus há ressurreição dos mortos. \v 3 Eles os prenderam e, como já anoitecia, os mantiveram sob guarda até o dia seguinte.
pt.R: Pedro e João ainda estavam falando com o povo quando alguns sacerdotes chegaram perto deles. O comandante da guarda do templo e alguns saduceus vieram também. \v 2 Eles estavam muito zangados, porque os apóstolos ensinavam ao povo que, por causa de Jesus, os mortos vão ressuscitar. \v 3 Então agarraram Pedro e João. Já estava anoitecendo, e por isso os puseram na prisão até o dia seguinte.

am.L: ለሕዝቡም ሲናገሩ ሳሉ ካህናቱና የቤተ መቅደሱ አዛዥ ሰዱቃውያንም ወደ እነርሱ መጡ፤ \v 2 ሕዝቡን ስለሚያስተምሩና በኢየሱስ ከሙታን መነሣትን ስለሚሰብኩ እጅግ ተበሳጭተው ነበር። \v 3 እጃቸውንም ጫኑባቸው፤ ጊዜውም አሁን መሽቶ ነበርና እስከ ማግሥቱ ድረስ በጥበቃ አኖሯቸው።
am.B: ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ ገና ለሕዝቡ እየተናገሩ ሳሉ ካህናቱ፣ የቤተ መቅደሱ ጠባቂዎች አዛዥና ሰዱቃውያን ወደ እነርሱ መጡ። \v 2 እነዚህ ሰዎች ሐዋርያት ሕዝቡን ስለሚያስተምሩና በኢየሱስ የሙታን ትንሣኤ እንዳለ ስለሚሰብኩ እጅግ ተበሳጭተው ነበር። \v 3 ስለዚህ ያዟቸው፤ ጊዜው መሽቶ ስለ ነበረም እስከ ማግሥቱ ድረስ በጥበቃ አቆዩአቸው።
am.R: ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ ገና ለሕዝቡ እየተናገሩ ሳሉ አንዳንድ ካህናት ወደ እነርሱ መጡ። የቤተ መቅደሱ ጠባቂዎች አለቃና አንዳንድ ሰዱቃውያንም አብረው መጡ። \v 2 እጅግ ተቆጥተው ነበር፤ ምክንያቱም ሐዋርያት በኢየሱስ ምክንያት የሞቱ ሰዎች እንደ ገና ሕያዋን ሆነው እንደሚነሡ ሕዝቡን ያስተምሩ ነበር። \v 3 ስለዚህ ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስን ያዟቸው። ጊዜው መሽቶ ስለ ነበረ እስከ ማግሥቱ ድረስ እስር ቤት አስገቧቸው።

hi.L: और जब वे लोगों से बातें कर ही रहे थे, तो याजक और मन्दिर का सरदार और सदूकी उन पर चढ़ आए, \v 2 क्योंकि वे बहुत क्रोधित थे कि वे लोगों को सिखाते थे और यीशु में मरे हुओं में से जी उठने का प्रचार करते थे। \v 3 और उन्होंने उन पर हाथ डाले और उन्हें अगले दिन तक हवालात में रखा, क्योंकि साँझ हो चुकी थी।
hi.B: पतरस और यूहन्ना अभी लोगों से बात कर ही रहे थे कि याजक, मन्दिर के पहरेदारों का सरदार और सदूकी उनके सामने आ खड़े हुए। \v 2 वे इस बात से बहुत चिढ़े हुए थे कि प्रेरित लोगों को सिखा रहे थे और यह प्रचार कर रहे थे कि यीशु में मरे हुओं का जी उठना है। \v 3 उन्होंने उन्हें पकड़ लिया, और क्योंकि साँझ हो चुकी थी, उन्हें अगले दिन तक पहरे में रखा।
hi.R: पतरस और यूहन्ना अभी लोगों से बात कर ही रहे थे कि कुछ याजक उनके पास आए। मन्दिर के पहरेदारों का सरदार और कुछ सदूकी भी आए। \v 2 वे बहुत ग़ुस्से में थे, क्योंकि प्रेरित लोगों को सिखा रहे थे कि यीशु के कारण मरे हुए लोग फिर से जी उठेंगे। \v 3 इसलिए उन्होंने पतरस और यूहन्ना को पकड़ लिया। साँझ हो चुकी थी, इसलिए उन्होंने उन्हें अगले दिन तक जेल में डाल दिया।

ru.L: Когда же они говорили народу, к ним подошли священники, и начальник Храма, и саддукеи, \v 2 возмущаясь тем, что они учат народ и возвещают в Иисусе воскресение из мёртвых. \v 3 И наложили на них руки и отдали под стражу до следующего дня, ведь был уже вечер.
ru.B: Пётр и Иоанн ещё говорили с народом, когда к ним подошли священники, начальник храмовой стражи и саддукеи. \v 2 Они были крайне раздражены тем, что апостолы учат народ и возвещают, что в Иисусе есть воскресение из мёртвых. \v 3 Они схватили апостолов и, так как был уже вечер, держали их под стражей до следующего дня.
ru.R: Пётр и Иоанн ещё говорили с людьми, когда к ним подошли священники. Пришли и начальник храмовой стражи, и несколько саддукеев. \v 2 Они очень рассердились, потому что апостолы учили народ, что благодаря Иисусу умершие воскреснут. \v 3 Поэтому они схватили Петра и Иоанна. Был уже вечер, и их посадили в тюрьму до следующего дня.

uk.L: А поки вони говорили до народу, до них приступили священники, і начальник храму, і садукеї, \v 2 обурені тим, що вони навчають народ і звіщають в Ісусі воскресіння з мертвих. \v 3 І наклали на них руки, і посадили [їх] під варту до наступного дня, бо вже був вечір.
uk.B: Петро й Іван ще говорили до народу, коли до них підступили священники, начальник храмової варти й садукеї. \v 2 Їх дуже дратувало те, що апостоли навчають народ і звіщають, що в Ісусі — воскресіння з мертвих. \v 3 Вони схопили їх і, оскільки вже настав вечір, тримали під вартою до наступного дня.
uk.R: Петро й Іван ще розмовляли з людьми, коли до них підійшли якісь священники. Начальник храмової варти й кілька садукеїв теж прийшли. \v 2 Вони дуже розгнівалися, бо апостоли навчали людей, що завдяки Ісусові мертві знову оживуть. \v 3 Тож вони схопили Петра й Івана. Був уже вечір, тому їх посадили до вʼязниці до наступного дня.

ja.L: そして彼らが民に語っていると、祭司たちと神殿守衛長とサドカイ派の人々が彼らのところにやって来た。\v 2 彼らが民を教え、イエスにおいて死者からの復活を告げ伝えていることに、ひどくいらだっていたのである。\v 3 そして彼らに手をかけ、翌日まで留置した。すでに夕方だったからである。
ja.B: ペトロとヨハネがまだ民衆に語っているうちに、祭司たちと神殿守衛長とサドカイ派の人々が二人に詰め寄った。\v 2 使徒たちが民衆を教え、イエスにおいて死者の復活があると告げ伝えていたので、彼らはひどくいらだっていたのである。\v 3 彼らは二人を捕らえたが、すでに夕方になっていたので、翌日まで監禁しておいた。
ja.R: ペトロとヨハネがまだ人々に話していると、祭司たちが何人か二人のところにやって来ました。神殿の警備隊の隊長と、サドカイ派の人々も来ました。\v 2 彼らはとても怒っていました。使徒たちが人々を教え、イエスのおかげで死んだ人たちが生き返ることを伝えていたからです。\v 3 そこで彼らはペトロとヨハネを捕まえました。もう夕方だったので、二人を次の日まで牢に入れておきました。

decisions.choice: the captain of the temple: the priest in command of the temple guard
decisions.reason: He was a senior priest who kept order in the temple courts with a force of Levites. Luke mentions such officers again in Luke 22:4 and Acts 5:24-26.

decisions.choice: the Sadducees: a party of the priestly upper class who denied the resurrection
decisions.reason: Luke says they held that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit (Luke 20:27; Acts 23:8). That explains their anger at what the apostles taught.

decisions.choice: in Jesus: Jesus's own rising shows, and brings about, the resurrection of the dead
alternatives: only that the dead rise through him
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean "in the case of Jesus" or "by means of Jesus". Both may be in view: his resurrection is the first, and others follow through him (compare 26:23; 1 Corinthians 15:20-22).

decisions.choice: greatly annoyed: deeply irritated
decisions.reason: The verb means to be worn out and provoked by something (16:18).

decisions.choice: until the next day: too late for a hearing
decisions.reason: It was evening, so the hearing was put off to the morning (4:5). The custody was a holding until then, not a punishment.

decisions.choice: the commander of the temple guard
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the officer commanded; Literal keeps the title.

decisions.choice: because of Jesus, dead people will rise to life again
alternatives: in Jesus the resurrection from the dead
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the sense that the resurrection comes through Jesus, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R), with the imperfect for background
decisions.reason: As in the Gospels (style guide §3, §9): the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits a careful public reading; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and as young readers meet stories. Speeches and prayers keep the tenses of speech at every level. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: les Sadducéens, capitalised
decisions.reason: The style guide's term for the party, capitalised like les Pharisiens (§9).

decisions.choice: mkuu wa [walinzi wa] hekalu (L); mkuu wa walinzi wa hekalu (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Acts 5:24: the priest in command of the temple guard (meaning decision on the captain of the temple). "Mkuu wa hekalu" alone would sound like the head of the whole temple, so Literal brackets the words it supplies.

decisions.choice: el capitán del templo (L, B); el jefe de la guardia del templo (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:24: the priest in command of the temple guard (meaning decision on the captain of the temple); Readable says what he commanded.

decisions.choice: "viên chỉ huy đền thờ" (L); "viên chỉ huy lính canh đền thờ" (B, R); "người Sa-đu-sê"
decisions.reason: The priest in command of the temple guard (meaning decision), worded as the guards' commanders in the Vietnamese Luke 22:4; "người Sa-đu-sê" as in the Gospels.

decisions.choice: The narrator calls Peter and John "hai ông", each of them "ông" (whole book, for the apostles and other grown men)
decisions.reason: "ông" is the respectful third person the Vietnamese Luke uses for grown men in its narrative, as for Peter in Luke 22:33.

decisions.choice: "성전 경비대장"; "사두개파 사람들" at every level
decisions.reason: The captain of the temple was the priest in command of the temple guard (meaning decision), which "경비대장" says. "사두개파 사람들" is the form of the Korean Gospels (Mark 12:18; Luke 20:27).

decisions.choice: o capitão do templo (L); o chefe da guarda do templo (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Luke 22:4 does for the same title in the plural: Literal keeps the title, and Balanced and Readable say what the officer led, the temple guard (m1). "Comandante" would suggest an army.

decisions.choice: "मन्दिर का सरदार" (L); "मन्दिर के पहरेदारों का सरदार" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The officer who commanded the temple guard (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable say so, as Luke 22:4 does in Hindi.

decisions.choice: начальник Храма (L); начальник храмовой стражи (B, R)
decisions.reason: The officer was the priest in command of the temple guard; Balanced and Readable say so, as in Luke 22:4.

decisions.choice: "начальник храму" (L), "начальник храмової варти" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The title named the priest who commanded the temple guard; Balanced and Readable say so. Kept the same in 5:24 and 5:26.

decisions.choice: narration in the plain style (L, B) and in です・ます (R)
decisions.reason: Following the Japanese brief for narrative books: Literal and Balanced narrate in the plain style, Readable in です・ます. Light honorifics are kept for what God, Jesus and the Holy Spirit do.

decisions.choice: "神殿守衛長" (L, B); "神殿の警備隊の隊長" (R)
decisions.reason: The title of the priest in command of the temple guard (m1), as in the shared Acts terms; Readable says what he commanded.

source.text: πολλοὶ δὲ τῶν ἀκουσάντων τὸν λόγον ἐπίστευσαν, καὶ ἐγενήθη ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν ἀνδρῶν ὡς χιλιάδες πέντε.

records.literal_gloss: Many however of those having heard the word believed, and became the number of the men about thousands five.

en.L: But many of those who had heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to about 5,000.
en.B: Even so, many who heard the message came to believe, and the count of men rose to about 5,000.
en.R: But many of the people who heard the message believed in Jesus. Now there were about 5,000 men who believed.

fr.L: Mais beaucoup de ceux qui avaient entendu la parole crurent, et le nombre des hommes atteignit environ cinq mille.
fr.B: Malgré cela, beaucoup de ceux qui entendirent le message devinrent croyants, et le nombre des hommes s’éleva à environ cinq mille.
fr.R: Mais beaucoup de gens qui avaient entendu le message ont cru en Jésus. Maintenant, il y avait environ cinq mille hommes qui croyaient.

sw.L: Lakini wengi wa wale waliolisikia neno waliamini, na idadi ya wanaume ikawa kama elfu tano.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, wengi waliosikia ujumbe waliamini, na idadi ya wanaume ikafikia karibu elfu tano.
sw.R: Lakini watu wengi waliosikia ujumbe huo walimwamini Yesu. Sasa kulikuwa na wanaume wapatao elfu tano walioamini.

es.L: Pero muchos de los que habían oído la palabra creyeron, y el número de los hombres llegó a ser de unos 5 000.
es.B: Aun así, muchos de los que oyeron el mensaje creyeron, y el número de los hombres llegó a unos 5 000.
es.R: Pero muchas de las personas que oyeron el mensaje creyeron en Jesús. Ahora había unos 5 000 hombres que creían.

vi.L: Nhưng nhiều người đã nghe lời [ấy] thì tin, và số người nam lên đến chừng năm nghìn.
vi.B: Dù vậy, nhiều người đã nghe sứ điệp thì tin, và số người nam tăng lên chừng năm nghìn.
vi.R: Nhưng nhiều người đã nghe sứ điệp thì tin Đức Giê-xu. Bây giờ đã có chừng năm nghìn người nam tin Chúa.

ko.L: 그러나 말씀을 들은 사람들 가운데 많은 사람이 믿었고, 남자의 수가 오천 명쯤 되었다.
ko.B: 그러나 말씀을 들은 사람들 가운데 많은 사람이 믿게 되어, 남자만 세어도 그 수가 오천 명쯤 되었다.
ko.R: 그러나 그 말씀을 들은 많은 사람이 예수를 믿었다. 이제 믿는 남자들이 오천 명쯤 되었다.

pt.L: Mas muitos dos que tinham ouvido a palavra creram, e o número dos homens chegou a cerca de cinco mil.
pt.B: Mesmo assim, muitos dos que ouviram a mensagem creram, e o número dos homens chegou a uns cinco mil.
pt.R: Mas muitas das pessoas que ouviram a mensagem acreditaram em Jesus. Agora havia cerca de cinco mil homens que acreditavam nele.

am.L: ቃሉን ከሰሙት ግን ብዙዎች አመኑ፤ የወንዶቹም ቁጥር 5000 ያህል ሆነ።
am.B: ይሁን እንጂ መልእክቱን ከሰሙት ብዙዎች አመኑ፤ የወንዶቹም ቁጥር 5000 ያህል ደረሰ።
am.R: ነገር ግን መልእክቱን ከሰሙት ሰዎች ብዙዎቹ በኢየሱስ አመኑ። አሁን ያመኑት ወንዶች 5000 ያህል ነበሩ።

hi.L: पर वचन के सुननेवालों में से बहुतों ने विश्वास किया, और पुरुषों की गिनती लगभग पाँच हज़ार हो गई।
hi.B: फिर भी संदेश सुननेवालों में से बहुतों ने विश्वास किया, और पुरुषों की गिनती बढ़कर लगभग पाँच हज़ार हो गई।
hi.R: पर संदेश सुननेवाले बहुत-से लोगों ने यीशु पर विश्वास किया। अब विश्वास करनेवाले पुरुषों की गिनती लगभग पाँच हज़ार हो गई।

ru.L: Многие же из слышавших слово уверовали, и число мужчин стало около 5000.
ru.B: Но многие из тех, кто слышал весть, уверовали, и число одних мужчин достигло примерно 5000.
ru.R: Но многие люди, которые слышали эту весть, поверили в Иисуса. Теперь только мужчин, которые верили, было около 5000.

uk.L: Але багато з тих, хто почув слово, увірували, і число чоловіків стало близько 5000.
uk.B: І все ж багато хто з тих, хто почув слово, увірував, і число чоловіків сягнуло близько 5000.
uk.R: Але багато з тих, хто почув слово, повірили в Ісуса. Тепер віруючих чоловіків було близько 5000.

ja.L: しかし、言葉を聞いた者たちのうち多くの者が信じ、男の数がおよそ五千になった。
ja.B: それでも、言葉を聞いた人々の多くが信じ、男の数は五千人ほどになった。
ja.R: けれども、その話を聞いた多くの人がイエスを信じました。信じた男の人は、今では五千人ほどになりました。

decisions.choice: the word: the message about Jesus
decisions.reason: As in 2:41, "the word" is the message the apostles preached.

decisions.choice: men: adult males
decisions.reason: The word usually means males, and Luke may count the men only, as in Luke 9:14. It can also stand for people in general, so the number may include women.

decisions.choice: the number: the whole number of believers now
alternatives: the number who believed that day
decisions.reason: The verb means that the number came to this total. Added to the 3,000 of 2:41 and those added daily (2:47), the whole community now reached about 5,000 men.

decisions.choice: believed in Jesus; men who believed
decisions.reason: Readable says in whom they believed, and that the count is of believers.

decisions.choice: "lời [ấy]" (L); "sứ điệp" (B, R) for "the word"
decisions.reason: The message about Jesus (meaning decision); lowercase "lời" as in the Vietnamese Luke 1:2, with "sứ điệp" where the English says "message".

decisions.choice: "người nam" for the men
decisions.reason: The word means adult males (meaning decision), so Vietnamese names them as men.

decisions.choice: "남자" at every level, with "남자만 세어도" (B)
decisions.reason: The word here means adult males (meaning decision); the count is of men, so Korean says "남자" and does not make it inclusive.

decisions.choice: "पुरुष", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The count is of adult men (meaning decision m2), so Hindi says "पुरुष" at every level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: мужчин
decisions.reason: The Greek word here counts adult men (meaning decision), so no gender setting is used.

source.text: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐπὶ τὴν αὔριον συναχθῆναι αὐτῶν τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους καὶ τοὺς γραμματεῖς ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ καὶ Ἅννας ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ Καϊάφας καὶ Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἀλέξανδρος καὶ ὅσοι ἦσαν ἐκ γένους ἀρχιερατικοῦ, καὶ στήσαντες αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ μέσῳ ἐπυνθάνοντο· Ἐν ποίᾳ δυνάμει ἢ ἐν ποίῳ ὀνόματι ἐποιήσατε τοῦτο ὑμεῖς;

records.literal_gloss: It came to pass then on the next day were gathered of them the rulers and the elders and the scribes in Jerusalem, \v 6 and Annas the high priest and Caiaphas and John and Alexander and as many as were of family high-priestly, \v 7 and having set them in the midst they were inquiring, By what power or in what name did this you?

en.L: And it came about on the next day that their rulers and elders and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem, \v 6 and Annas the high priest and Caiaphas and John and Alexander, and as many as were of high-priestly descent. \v 7 And having set them in the middle, they began to inquire, "By what power or in what name did you do this?"
en.B: The next day the people's rulers, elders and experts in the law met together in Jerusalem. \v 6 Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander and all the others from the high priest's family. \v 7 They had the two men stand in the center of the gathering and began questioning them: "What sort of power, or what sort of name, did you use to do this?"
en.R: The next day the Jewish rulers, the elders and the teachers of the law met in Jerusalem. \v 6 Annas the high priest was there. Caiaphas, John, Alexander and the other men from the high priest's family were there too. \v 7 They made Peter and John stand in front of them. Then they asked, "How did you heal this man? What power did you use? Whose name did you use?"

fr.L: Or il arriva, le lendemain, que leurs chefs, leurs anciens et leurs scribes se rassemblèrent à Jérusalem, \v 6 ainsi qu’Anne le grand prêtre, Caïphe, Jean, Alexandre et tous ceux qui étaient de la famille des grands prêtres. \v 7 Et les ayant placés au milieu, ils se mirent à demander : « Par quelle puissance ou par quel nom avez-vous fait cela, vous ? »
fr.B: Le lendemain, les chefs du peuple, les anciens et les scribes se réunirent à Jérusalem. \v 6 Il y avait là Anne, le grand prêtre, avec Caïphe, Jean, Alexandre et tous les autres membres de la famille du grand prêtre. \v 7 Ils firent placer les deux hommes au milieu de l’assemblée et se mirent à les interroger : « Par quelle puissance, ou au nom de qui, avez-vous fait cela ? »
fr.R: Le lendemain, les chefs juifs, les anciens et les spécialistes de la Loi se sont réunis à Jérusalem. \v 6 Anne, le grand prêtre, était là. Caïphe, Jean, Alexandre et les autres hommes de la famille du grand prêtre étaient là aussi. \v 7 Ils ont fait venir Pierre et Jean devant eux. Puis ils leur ont demandé : « Comment avez-vous guéri cet homme ? Quelle puissance avez-vous utilisée ? Au nom de qui l’avez-vous fait ? »

sw.L: Ikawa kesho yake viongozi wao na wazee na waandishi walikusanyika Yerusalemu, \v 6 na Anasi kuhani mkuu na Kayafa na Yohana na Aleksanda, na wote waliokuwa wa ukoo wa kuhani mkuu. \v 7 Na baada ya kuwasimamisha katikati, wakaanza kuuliza, "Ni kwa nguvu gani au kwa jina gani ninyi mmefanya jambo hili?"
sw.B: Kesho yake viongozi wa watu, wazee na waandishi walikutana pamoja Yerusalemu. \v 6 Anasi kuhani mkuu alikuwepo, pamoja na Kayafa, Yohana, Aleksanda na wengine wote wa jamaa ya kuhani mkuu. \v 7 Waliwasimamisha wale wawili katikati ya mkutano, wakaanza kuwahoji: "Mlitumia nguvu gani, au jina gani, kufanya jambo hili?"
sw.R: Kesho yake viongozi wa Kiyahudi, wazee na walimu wa sheria walikutana Yerusalemu. \v 6 Anasi kuhani mkuu alikuwepo. Kayafa, Yohana, Aleksanda na wanaume wengine wa jamaa ya kuhani mkuu walikuwepo pia. \v 7 Waliwasimamisha Petro na Yohana mbele yao. Kisha wakauliza, "Mlimponyaje mtu huyu? Mlitumia nguvu gani? Mlitumia jina la nani?"

es.L: Y sucedió al día siguiente que se reunieron en Jerusalén sus gobernantes, los ancianos y los escribas, \v 6 y Anás el sumo sacerdote, y Caifás, y Juan, y Alejandro, y todos los que eran de familia de sumos sacerdotes. \v 7 Y poniéndolos en medio, les preguntaban: «¿Con qué poder o en qué nombre {{plural_you:hicieron esto ustedes|hicisteis esto vosotros}}?».
es.B: Al día siguiente se reunieron en Jerusalén los gobernantes del pueblo, los ancianos y los escribas. \v 6 Estaban allí Anás, el sumo sacerdote, Caifás, Juan, Alejandro y todos los demás de la familia del sumo sacerdote. \v 7 Hicieron que los dos hombres se pusieran de pie en medio de ellos y comenzaron a interrogarlos: «¿Con qué poder, o en nombre de quién, {{plural_you:han hecho ustedes|habéis hecho vosotros}} esto?».
es.R: Al día siguiente, los gobernantes judíos, los ancianos y los maestros de la ley se reunieron en Jerusalén. \v 6 Allí estaba Anás, el sumo sacerdote. También estaban Caifás, Juan, Alejandro y los demás hombres de la familia del sumo sacerdote. \v 7 Hicieron que Pedro y Juan se pusieran de pie delante de ellos. Entonces les preguntaron: «¿Cómo {{plural_you:sanaron|sanasteis}} a este hombre? ¿Qué poder {{plural_you:usaron|usasteis}}? ¿En nombre de quién lo {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}}?».

vi.L: Đến hôm sau, các nhà cầm quyền, các trưởng lão và các thầy thông giáo của họ nhóm họp tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, \v 6 cùng với thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm An-ne, Cai-phe, Giăng, A-léc-xan-đơ, và tất cả những người thuộc dòng họ thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm. \v 7 Họ cho hai ông đứng ở giữa và tra hỏi: "Các người đã nhờ quyền năng nào hay nhân danh ai mà làm việc này?"
vi.B: Hôm sau, các nhà cầm quyền của dân, các trưởng lão và các thầy thông giáo nhóm họp tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. \v 6 Có mặt ở đó có thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm An-ne, cùng với Cai-phe, Giăng, A-léc-xan-đơ và mọi người khác trong gia đình thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm. \v 7 Họ cho hai người đứng ở giữa hội đồng và bắt đầu tra hỏi: "Các người đã dùng quyền năng gì, hay nhân danh ai, mà làm việc này?"
vi.R: Hôm sau, các nhà lãnh đạo Do Thái, các trưởng lão và các thầy dạy luật họp lại tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. \v 6 Thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm An-ne có ở đó. Cai-phe, Giăng, A-léc-xan-đơ và những người khác trong gia đình thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm cũng có mặt. \v 7 Họ bắt Phi-e-rơ và Giăng đứng trước mặt họ. Rồi họ hỏi: "Các người đã chữa lành người này bằng cách nào? Các người đã dùng quyền năng gì? Các người đã nhân danh ai?"

ko.L: 그리고 다음 날 [이런] 일이 있었다. 그들의 지도자들과 장로들과 율법학자들이 예루살렘에 모였다. \v 6 대제사장 안나스와 가야바와 요한과 알렉산더와 대제사장 가문에 속한 사람들이 모두 [함께 있었다]. \v 7 그들은 사도들을 가운데 세우고 물었다. "너희는 무슨 능력으로, 또 누구의 이름으로 이 일을 하였느냐?"
ko.B: 이튿날 백성의 지도자들과 장로들과 율법학자들이 예루살렘에 모였다. \v 6 대제사장 안나스를 비롯하여 가야바와 요한과 알렉산더와 대제사장 가문의 다른 사람들도 모두 그 자리에 있었다. \v 7 그들은 두 사람을 한가운데 세워 놓고 심문했다. "너희는 도대체 무슨 능력으로, 누구의 이름으로 이런 일을 했느냐?"
ko.R: 이튿날 유대인의 지도자들과 장로들과 율법 선생들이 예루살렘에 모였다. \v 6 대제사장 안나스도 그 자리에 있었다. 가야바와 요한과 알렉산더와 대제사장 집안의 다른 남자들도 모두 함께 있었다. \v 7 그들은 베드로와 요한을 자기들 앞에 세워 놓고 물었다. "너희는 이 사람을 어떻게 고쳤느냐? 무슨 능력을 썼느냐? 누구의 이름을 썼느냐?"

pt.L: E aconteceu que no dia seguinte se reuniram em Jerusalém os governantes deles, os anciãos e os escribas, \v 6 e Anás, o sumo sacerdote, e Caifás e João e Alexandre, e quantos eram de família de sumo sacerdote. \v 7 E, pondo-os no meio, perguntavam: "Com que poder ou em que nome fizeram isto vocês?"
pt.B: No dia seguinte, as autoridades do povo, os anciãos e os escribas se reuniram em Jerusalém. \v 6 Estavam ali Anás, o sumo sacerdote, Caifás, João, Alexandre e todos os outros da família do sumo sacerdote. \v 7 Mandaram que os dois homens ficassem de pé no meio da reunião e começaram a interrogá-los: "Com que tipo de poder, ou em nome de quem, vocês fizeram isto?"
pt.R: No dia seguinte, os líderes dos judeus, os anciãos e os mestres da Lei se reuniram em Jerusalém. \v 6 Anás, o sumo sacerdote, estava ali. Caifás, João, Alexandre e os outros homens da família do sumo sacerdote também estavam. \v 7 Eles fizeram Pedro e João ficar de pé na frente deles. Então perguntaram: "Como vocês curaram este homem? Que poder vocês usaram? Em nome de quem vocês fizeram isso?"

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በማግሥቱ አለቆቻቸው፣ ሽማግሌዎችና ጸሐፍት በኢየሩሳሌም ተሰበሰቡ፤ \v 6 ሊቀ ካህናቱ ሐናም ቀያፋም ዮሐንስም እስክንድርም ከሊቀ ካህናቱ ወገን የነበሩትም ሁሉ [ነበሩ]። \v 7 እነርሱንም በመካከላቸው አቁመው፦ «በምን ኃይል ወይም በምን ስም ነው እናንተ ይህን ያደረጋችሁት?» ብለው ይጠይቋቸው ጀመር።
am.B: በማግሥቱ የሕዝቡ አለቆች፣ ሽማግሌዎችና የሕግ መምህራን በኢየሩሳሌም ተሰበሰቡ። \v 6 ሊቀ ካህናቱ ሐና፣ ቀያፋ፣ ዮሐንስ፣ እስክንድርና ከሊቀ ካህናቱ ቤተሰብ የሆኑት ሌሎቹ ሁሉ በዚያ ነበሩ። \v 7 ሁለቱን ሰዎች በጉባኤው መካከል አቁመው፦ «ይህን ያደረጋችሁት በምን ዓይነት ኃይል ወይም በምን ዓይነት ስም ነው?» ብለው ይጠይቋቸው ጀመር።
am.R: በማግሥቱ የአይሁድ አለቆች፣ ሽማግሌዎችና የሕግ መምህራን በኢየሩሳሌም ተሰበሰቡ። \v 6 ሊቀ ካህናቱ ሐና በዚያ ነበረ። ቀያፋ፣ ዮሐንስ፣ እስክንድርና ከሊቀ ካህናቱ ቤተሰብ የሆኑት ሌሎቹ ሰዎችም በዚያ ነበሩ። \v 7 ጴጥሮስንና ዮሐንስን በፊታቸው አቆሟቸው። ከዚያም፦ «ይህን ሰው እንዴት ፈወሳችሁት? የተጠቀማችሁት በምን ኃይል ነው? በማንስ ስም ነው?» ብለው ጠየቋቸው።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि अगले दिन उनके सरदार और पुरनिए और शास्त्री यरूशलेम में इकट्ठे हुए, \v 6 और महायाजक हन्ना और कैफ़ा और यूहन्ना और सिकंदर, और जितने महायाजक के घराने के थे। \v 7 और उन्हें बीच में खड़ा करके वे पूछने लगे, "तुमने यह किस सामर्थ्य से या किस नाम से किया?"
hi.B: अगले दिन लोगों के सरदार, बुज़ुर्ग अगुवे और व्यवस्था के शिक्षक यरूशलेम में इकट्ठे हुए। \v 6 महायाजक हन्ना वहाँ था, और उसके साथ कैफ़ा, यूहन्ना, सिकंदर और महायाजक के घराने के सब लोग। \v 7 उन्होंने दोनों को सभा के बीच खड़ा किया और उनसे पूछने लगे, "तुमने यह काम किस सामर्थ्य से, या किसके नाम से किया?"
hi.R: अगले दिन यहूदियों के सरदार, बुज़ुर्ग अगुवे और व्यवस्था के शिक्षक यरूशलेम में इकट्ठे हुए। \v 6 महायाजक हन्ना वहाँ था। कैफ़ा, यूहन्ना, सिकंदर और महायाजक के घराने के दूसरे पुरुष भी वहाँ थे। \v 7 उन्होंने पतरस और यूहन्ना को अपने सामने खड़ा किया। फिर उन्होंने पूछा, "तुमने इस आदमी को कैसे ठीक किया? तुमने किस सामर्थ्य का सहारा लिया? किसके नाम से यह किया?"

ru.L: Было же на следующий день: собрались в Иерусалиме их начальники, и старейшины, и книжники, \v 6 и Анна, первосвященник, и Каиафа, и Иоанн, и Александр, и сколько их было из первосвященнического рода. \v 7 И, поставив их посередине, спрашивали: «Какой силой или каким именем вы сделали это?»
ru.B: На следующий день в Иерусалиме собрались начальники народа, старейшины и учители Закона. \v 6 Там был первосвященник Анна, а также Каиафа, Иоанн, Александр и все остальные из семьи первосвященника. \v 7 Они поставили апостолов посередине собрания и стали допрашивать: «Какой силой или каким именем вы это сделали?»
ru.R: На следующий день в Иерусалиме собрались иудейские начальники, старейшины и учители Закона. \v 6 Там был первосвященник Анна. Были там и Каиафа, Иоанн, Александр и другие мужчины из семьи первосвященника. \v 7 Они поставили Петра и Иоанна перед собой и спросили: «Как вы исцелили этого человека? Какой силой? Чьим именем?»

uk.L: І сталося наступного дня, що зібралися в Єрусалимі їхні правителі, і старійшини, і книжники, \v 6 і Анна, первосвященик, і Каяфа, і Іван, і Олександр, і всі, хто був з первосвященицького роду. \v 7 І, поставивши їх посередині, почали допитуватися: «Якою силою або в чиє імʼя ви це зробили?»
uk.B: Наступного дня в Єрусалимі зібралися правителі народу, старійшини й учителі Закону. \v 6 Там був первосвященик Анна, а також Каяфа, Іван, Олександр і всі інші з роду первосвященика. \v 7 Вони поставили обох посеред зібрання і почали допитувати: «Якою силою чи яким імʼям ви це зробили?»
uk.R: Наступного дня в Єрусалимі зібралися юдейські правителі, старійшини й учителі Закону. \v 6 Там був первосвященик Анна. Каяфа, Іван, Олександр та інші чоловіки з родини первосвященика теж були там. \v 7 Вони поставили Петра й Івана перед собою і спитали: «Як ви зцілили цього чоловіка? Якою силою? Чиїм імʼям?»

ja.L: さて、翌日のことである。彼らの指導者たちと長老たちと律法学者たちがエルサレムに集まった。\v 6 大祭司アンナスとカイアファとヨハネとアレクサンドロと、大祭司の家系の者は皆[そこにいた]。\v 7 そして彼らを真ん中に立たせて、尋問し始めた。「どんな力によって、あるいはどんな名によって、おまえたちはこのことをしたのか？」
ja.B: 翌日、民の指導者たちと長老たちと律法学者たちがエルサレムに集まった。\v 6 大祭司アンナスがおり、カイアファ、ヨハネ、アレクサンドロ、そのほか大祭司の一族の者たちも皆いた。\v 7 彼らは二人を真ん中に立たせて、問いただし始めた。「いったいどんな力で、どんな名を使って、おまえたちはこんなことをしたのか？」
ja.R: 次の日、ユダヤ人の指導者たちと長老たちと律法の先生たちが、エルサレムに集まりました。\v 6 大祭司アンナスもいました。カイアファ、ヨハネ、アレクサンドロ、そのほか大祭司の家の男たちも皆いました。\v 7 彼らはペトロとヨハネを自分たちの前に立たせて、尋ねました。「おまえたちは、どうやってこの男を治したのか？どんな力を使ったのか？だれの名を使ったのか？」

decisions.choice: rulers, elders and scribes: the members of the Jewish high council
decisions.reason: These groups together made up the council in Jerusalem (4:15; Luke 22:66). "Their" means the rulers of the Jewish people.

decisions.choice: Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas
alternatives: Annas was the high priest in office
decisions.reason: Annas had been high priest years before and kept the title and great influence. His son-in-law Caiaphas held the office at this time (Luke 3:2; John 18:13).

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "John"
decisions.reason: One important manuscript, Codex Bezae, has "Jonathan", the name of a son of Annas who later became high priest. Most manuscripts have "John". Neither John nor Alexander is otherwise known. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: you: placed last, with weight
decisions.reason: The pronoun is written out and stands at the end, so it is stressed: men like you. It may carry scorn, which suits 4:13, but it may only point to them.

decisions.choice: this: the healing of the lame man
decisions.reason: Peter takes it so in 4:9.

decisions.choice: experts in the law; teachers of the law
decisions.reason: Scribes were scholars of the law of Moses; Balanced and Readable say so, and Literal keeps "scribes".

decisions.choice: How did you heal this man?
decisions.reason: Readable names what "this" refers to.

decisions.choice: les scribes (L, B); les spécialistes de la Loi (R)
alternatives: les spécialistes de la Loi at Balanced, as the English "experts in the law"
decisions.reason: The style guide's term sheet keeps "les scribes" at Balanced, a known word in French for the scholars of the Law of Moses; Readable says who they were, as the English does. "Le grand prêtre" is written without a hyphen (§9).

decisions.choice: viongozi, wazee na waandishi (L, B); viongozi wa Kiyahudi, wazee na walimu wa sheria (R)
alternatives: wataalamu wa sheria (B), as the English "experts in the law"
decisions.reason: The members of the high council (meaning decision on rulers, elders and scribes). The scribes are "waandishi", the New Testament name for them, at Literal and Balanced, and "walimu wa sheria" at Readable, as in Mark and Luke; "wataalamu wa sheria" is kept for the different Greek word for lawyers.

decisions.choice: escribas (L, B); maestros de la ley (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice for the scribes: the traditional word at Literal and Balanced, and what they did at Readable.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:hicieron esto ustedes|hicisteis esto vosotros}}
decisions.reason: The council speaks to Peter and John, and they to the council; every plural "you" in the chapter is the plural_you setting. Literal keeps "ustedes" last, as the Greek puts "you" last for weight.

decisions.choice: "các nhà cầm quyền", "các trưởng lão", "các thầy thông giáo" (L, B); "các nhà lãnh đạo", "các trưởng lão", "các thầy dạy luật" (R)
decisions.reason: The members of the high council (meaning decision), with the Gospels' words for elders and scribes.

decisions.choice: The council speaks to the apostles as "các người"
decisions.reason: The rulers question men they hold to be beneath them and in the wrong; "các người" is distant and cold without being an insult, as when the Vietnamese Luke's Jesus speaks to opponents. The apostles answer the council as "các ông" (4:9-12, 4:19).

decisions.choice: the council speaks to the apostles in 해라체 ("너희", "-하였느냐?" at Literal, "-했느냐?" at Balanced and Readable), with "너희" placed first
decisions.reason: The high council questions two Galilean fishermen as judges question the accused; the plain style marks the authority they claim and their hostility, as the leaders speak to Jesus without honorifics in the Korean Luke 20:2. The apostles answer them in 합쇼체.

decisions.choice: "지도자들", "장로들", "율법학자들" (L, B), "율법 선생들" (R); "대제사장"; "안나스", "가야바"
decisions.reason: The three groups of the council (meaning decision), worded as in the Korean Luke (20:1; 22:66) and the Korean John (18:13). "알렉산더" is the Protestant form of the name.

decisions.choice: "그리고 다음 날 [이런] 일이 있었다" (L) for "and it came about", through Acts
alternatives: the formula left out at Literal
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 1:8 and 24:4 render Luke's "it came to pass" at Literal.

decisions.choice: os escribas (L, B); os mestres da Lei (R)
decisions.reason: As the style guide (section 6) and Luke's Gospel have it, Balanced keeps "escribas" where the English Balanced says "experts in the law"; Luke's "especialistas na Lei" renders a different Greek word (Luke 7:30), and keeping the two apart lets readers tell them apart.

decisions.choice: fizeram isto vocês?
decisions.reason: Literal puts "vocês" last, as the Greek does, to keep its weight (m4); Portuguese allows the subject at the end of a question. The council, as officials speaking to ordinary men, says "vocês".

decisions.choice: "ጸሐፍት" (scribes, L); "የሕግ መምህራን" (teachers of the Law, B, R); "ሊቀ ካህናት" (high priest) at every level
decisions.reason: As in the Gospels: the scribes were teachers of the Law, not copyists, so Balanced and Readable say what they did. "ሊቀ ካህናት" is the living Amharic title of the high priest.

decisions.choice: "पुरनिए", "शास्त्री" (L); "बुज़ुर्ग अगुवे", "व्यवस्था के शिक्षक" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's terms for elders and scribes (section 6), as in Luke 22:66.

decisions.choice: the council says "तुम" to the apostles
decisions.reason: The rulers speak down to the two men they are examining, so they say "तुम"; Peter answers them with "आप" (4:8-12), as the style guide has it for rulers.

decisions.choice: книжники (L); учители Закона (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the Gospels: the scribes were teachers of the Law, not copyists.

decisions.choice: старейшины
decisions.reason: The elders of the people are "старейшины" here; the church's elders (presbyteroi, 11:30 on) take the same word in this book.

decisions.choice: the council speaks plainly, with "おまえたち" for "you"
decisions.reason: Rulers questioning accused men speak in the plain style. The stressed pronoun at the end (m4) is given the curt "おまえたち", which can carry the scorn the meaning note allows without stating it.

decisions.choice: "カイアファ"; "アレクサンドロ"
decisions.reason: Caiaphas has the form used in the Gospels; Alexander, not in the brief's list, is transliterated from the Greek by the same pattern as other names in -os.

decisions.choice: "律法学者" (L, B); "律法の先生" (R)
decisions.reason: Scribes were scholars of the law of Moses; Readable uses an everyday word for them.

source.text: τότε Πέτρος πλησθεὶς πνεύματος ἁγίου εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Ἄρχοντες τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ πρεσβύτεροι, εἰ ἡμεῖς σήμερον ἀνακρινόμεθα ἐπὶ εὐεργεσίᾳ ἀνθρώπου ἀσθενοῦς, ἐν τίνι οὗτος σέσωσται, γνωστὸν ἔστω πᾶσιν ὑμῖν καὶ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ Ἰσραὴλ ὅτι ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Ναζωραίου, ὃν ὑμεῖς ἐσταυρώσατε, ὃν ὁ θεὸς ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐν τούτῳ οὗτος παρέστηκεν ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν ὑγιής.

records.literal_gloss: Then Peter having been filled with [the] Spirit Holy said to them, Rulers of the people and elders, \v 9 if we today are being examined on a good deed of a man sick, by what this [man] has been saved, \v 10 known let it be to all you and to all the people of Israel that in the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene, whom you crucified, whom the God raised from [the] dead, in this [one] this [man] stands before you healthy.

en.L: Then Peter, filled with [the] Holy Spirit, said to them, "Rulers of the people and elders, \v 9 if we are being examined today concerning a good deed [done] to a sick man, by what means this [man] has been made well, \v 10 let it be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel that in the name of Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} the Nazarene, whom you crucified, whom God raised from [the] dead, in this [one] this [man] stands before you healthy.
en.B: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, "Leaders of the people and elders, \v 9 since we are being questioned today about a kindness done for a disabled man, and how he was made well, \v 10 then all of you, and the whole people of Israel, must understand this. It was done in the name of Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} of Nazareth, whom you crucified and whom God raised from the dead. Through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} this man is standing in front of you, sound and whole.
en.R: Then the Holy Spirit filled Peter, and he said to them, "Leaders and elders of the people, \v 9 today you are asking us about something good we did for a man who could not walk. You want to know how he was made well. \v 10 All of you, and all the people of Israel, need to know this. This man was healed by the power of Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} from Nazareth. You nailed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to a cross, but God brought {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} back to life. Because of Jesus, this man is standing here in front of you, completely well.

fr.L: Alors Pierre, rempli de l’Esprit Saint, leur dit : « Chefs du peuple et anciens, \v 9 si nous sommes interrogés aujourd’hui au sujet d’un bienfait [accordé] à un homme infirme, [pour savoir] par quel moyen cet [homme] a été guéri, \v 10 qu’il soit connu de vous tous et de tout le peuple d’Israël que c’est dans le nom de Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} le Nazaréen, que vous avez crucifié, que Dieu a ressuscité d’entre les morts, c’est en lui que cet [homme] se tient devant vous en bonne santé.
fr.B: Alors Pierre, rempli de l’Esprit Saint, leur dit : « Chefs du peuple et anciens, \v 9 puisqu’on nous interroge aujourd’hui sur un bienfait accordé à un infirme, et sur la manière dont il a été guéri, \v 10 sachez-le bien, vous tous et le peuple d’Israël tout entier : cela s’est fait au nom de Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} de Nazareth, que vous avez crucifié et que Dieu a ressuscité des morts. C’est par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que cet homme se tient devant vous, en pleine santé.
fr.R: Alors l’Esprit Saint a rempli Pierre, et il leur a dit : « Chefs et anciens du peuple, \v 9 aujourd’hui, vous nous interrogez sur une bonne action que nous avons faite pour un homme qui ne pouvait pas marcher. Vous voulez savoir comment il a été guéri. \v 10 Vous tous, et tout le peuple d’Israël, vous devez savoir ceci. Cet homme a été guéri par la puissance de Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, de Nazareth. Vous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avez cloué sur une croix, mais Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ramené à la vie. C’est grâce à Jésus que cet homme est ici devant vous, en parfaite santé.

sw.L: Ndipo Petro, akiwa amejazwa Roho Mtakatifu, akawaambia, "Viongozi wa watu na wazee, \v 9 ikiwa sisi leo tunahojiwa kuhusu tendo jema [alilofanyiwa] mtu dhaifu, kwamba ni kwa njia gani mtu huyu ameponywa, \v 10 na ijulikane kwenu nyote na kwa watu wote wa Israeli kwamba kwa jina la Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Mnazareti, ambaye ninyi mlimsulubisha, ambaye Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu, kupitia huyo mtu huyu amesimama mbele yenu akiwa mzima.
sw.B: Ndipo Petro, akiwa amejaa Roho Mtakatifu, akawaambia, "Viongozi wa watu na wazee, \v 9 kwa kuwa leo tunahojiwa kuhusu wema uliofanyiwa mtu mlemavu, na jinsi alivyoponywa, \v 10 basi ninyi nyote, na watu wote wa Israeli, mnapaswa kujua jambo hili: Limefanyika kwa jina la Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wa Nazareti, ambaye ninyi mlimsulubisha, na ambaye Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu. Kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mtu huyu amesimama mbele yenu, akiwa mzima kabisa.
sw.R: Ndipo Roho Mtakatifu akamjaza Petro, naye akawaambia, "Viongozi na wazee wa watu, \v 9 leo mnatuuliza kuhusu jambo jema tulilomtendea mtu ambaye hakuweza kutembea. Mnataka kujua jinsi alivyoponywa. \v 10 Ninyi nyote, na watu wote wa Israeli, mnahitaji kujua jambo hili: Mtu huyu aliponywa kwa nguvu ya Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wa Nazareti. Ninyi mlimgongomea msalabani, lakini Mungu alimfufua. Kwa sababu ya Yesu, mtu huyu amesimama hapa mbele yenu, akiwa mzima kabisa.

es.L: Entonces Pedro, lleno del Espíritu Santo, les dijo: «Gobernantes del pueblo y ancianos, \v 9 si nosotros hoy somos interrogados acerca de un bien hecho a un hombre enfermo, de qué manera este ha sido sanado, \v 10 sea conocido de todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y de todo el pueblo de Israel que en el nombre de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} el Nazareno, a quien {{plural_you:ustedes crucificaron|vosotros crucificasteis}}, a quien Dios resucitó de entre [los] muertos, por este, este [hombre] se presenta sano delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Entonces Pedro, lleno del Espíritu Santo, les dijo: «Gobernantes del pueblo y ancianos: \v 9 puesto que hoy se nos interroga acerca de un bien hecho a un hombre enfermo, y de cómo fue sanado, \v 10 todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y todo el pueblo de Israel, {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} saber esto: se hizo en el nombre de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} de Nazaret, a quien {{plural_you:ustedes crucificaron|vosotros crucificasteis}} y a quien Dios resucitó de entre los muertos. Por medio de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} este hombre está aquí delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, sano y completo.
es.R: Entonces el Espíritu Santo llenó a Pedro, y él les dijo: «Gobernantes y ancianos del pueblo: \v 9 hoy nos {{plural_you:preguntan|preguntáis}} acerca de algo bueno que hicimos por un hombre que no podía caminar. {{plural_you:Quieren|Queréis}} saber cómo fue sanado. \v 10 Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y todo el pueblo de Israel, {{plural_you:necesitan|necesitáis}} saber esto: este hombre fue sanado por el poder de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} de Nazaret. {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:clavaron|clavasteis}} en una cruz, pero Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} volvió a la vida. Gracias a Jesús, este hombre está aquí delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, completamente sano.

vi.L: Bấy giờ Phi-e-rơ, được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh, nói với họ: "Thưa các nhà cầm quyền của dân và các trưởng lão, \v 9 nếu hôm nay chúng tôi bị tra hỏi về một việc lành làm cho một người tàn tật, rằng nhờ đâu người này được cứu, \v 10 thì xin tất cả các ông và toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên biết rằng: ấy là nhờ danh Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} người Na-xa-rét, Đấng mà các ông đã đóng đinh trên cây thập tự, Đấng mà Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến sống lại từ cõi chết; nhờ Đấng ấy mà người này đứng trước mặt các ông lành mạnh.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Phi-e-rơ, được đầy dẫy Đức Thánh Linh, nói với họ: "Thưa các nhà lãnh đạo của dân và các trưởng lão, \v 9 vì hôm nay chúng tôi bị tra hỏi về một việc tốt đã làm cho một người tàn tật, và về cách người ấy đã được lành, \v 10 thì xin tất cả các ông và toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên hiểu rõ điều này: việc ấy được làm nhân danh Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} người Na-xa-rét, Đấng các ông đã đóng đinh trên cây thập tự và Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến sống lại từ cõi chết. Nhờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà người này đang đứng trước mặt các ông, hoàn toàn lành mạnh.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Đức Thánh Linh đầy dẫy Phi-e-rơ, và ông nói với họ: "Thưa các nhà lãnh đạo và các trưởng lão của dân, \v 9 hôm nay các ông hỏi chúng tôi về một việc tốt chúng tôi đã làm cho một người không đi được. Các ông muốn biết người ấy đã được lành bằng cách nào. \v 10 Tất cả các ông và toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên cần biết điều này: Người này được chữa lành bởi quyền năng của Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} người Na-xa-rét. Các ông đã đóng đinh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên cây thập tự, nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại từ cõi chết. Nhờ Đức Giê-xu mà người này đang đứng đây trước mặt các ông, hoàn toàn khỏe mạnh.

ko.L: 그때에 베드로가 성령으로 충만하여 그들에게 말했다. "백성의 지도자들과 장로 여러분, \v 9 우리가 병든 사람에게 베푼 착한 일과 이 사람이 무엇으로 구원받았는지에 관하여 오늘 심문을 받는 것이라면, \v 10 여러분 모두와 온 이스라엘 백성은 이것을 아십시오. 여러분이 십자가에 못 박았고 하나님께서 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리신 나사렛 사람 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 이름으로, 이분으로 말미암아 이 사람이 성한 몸으로 여러분 앞에 서 있습니다.
ko.B: 그때 베드로가 성령으로 충만하여 그들에게 말했다. "백성의 지도자들과 장로 여러분, \v 9 오늘 우리가 몸이 불편한 사람에게 베푼 선한 일 때문에, 또 그가 어떻게 해서 낫게 되었는지에 관하여 심문을 받고 있으니, \v 10 여러분 모두와 온 이스라엘 백성은 이것을 아셔야 합니다. 이 일은 나사렛 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 이름으로 된 것입니다. 여러분은 이분을 십자가에 못 박았지만, 하나님께서는 이분을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리셨습니다. 이분 덕분에 이 사람이 온전한 몸으로 여러분 앞에 서 있는 것입니다.
ko.R: 그때 성령께서 베드로를 가득 채우셨다. 베드로가 그들에게 말했다. "백성의 지도자들과 장로 여러분, \v 9 오늘 여러분은 우리가 걷지 못하는 사람에게 해 준 좋은 일에 관하여 묻고 있습니다. 이 사람이 어떻게 낫게 되었는지 알고 싶어 합니다. \v 10 여러분 모두와 온 이스라엘 백성은 이것을 알아야 합니다. 이 사람은 나사렛에서 오신 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 능력으로 나았습니다. 여러분은 그분을 십자가에 못 박았습니다. 그러나 하나님께서 그분을 다시 살리셨습니다. 바로 예수 덕분에 이 사람이 완전히 나아서 여러분 앞에 서 있습니다.

pt.L: Então Pedro, cheio do Espírito Santo, lhes disse: "Chefes do povo e anciãos, \v 9 se hoje nós estamos sendo interrogados a respeito de um bem feito a um homem enfermo, [sobre] como este foi curado, \v 10 seja conhecido de todos os senhores e de todo o povo de Israel que, no nome de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, o nazareno, a quem os senhores crucificaram, a quem Deus ressuscitou dentre [os] mortos, por ele este [homem] está diante dos senhores com saúde.
pt.B: Então Pedro, cheio do Espírito Santo, lhes disse: "Líderes do povo e anciãos, \v 9 já que hoje estamos sendo interrogados por causa de um bem feito a um homem doente, e sobre o modo como ele foi curado, \v 10 saibam todos os senhores, e todo o povo de Israel, isto: foi em nome de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, de Nazaré, a quem os senhores crucificaram e a quem Deus ressuscitou dentre os mortos. É por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} que este homem está aqui diante dos senhores, são e perfeito.
pt.R: Então o Espírito Santo encheu Pedro, e ele disse a eles: "Líderes e anciãos do povo, \v 9 hoje os senhores estão nos interrogando sobre uma coisa boa que fizemos por um homem que não podia andar. Os senhores querem saber como ele foi curado. \v 10 Todos os senhores, e todo o povo de Israel, precisam saber isto: este homem foi curado pelo poder de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, de Nazaré. Os senhores {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} pregaram numa cruz, mas Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} trouxe de volta à vida. Por causa de Jesus, este homem está aqui na frente dos senhores, completamente curado.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ ጴጥሮስ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተሞልቶ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «የሕዝብ አለቆችና ሽማግሌዎች ሆይ፣ \v 9 እኛ ዛሬ ለደካማ ሰው ስለ ተደረገው መልካም ሥራ፣ ይህም ሰው በምን እንደ ዳነ የምንመረመር ከሆነ፣ \v 10 እናንተ የሰቀላችሁት፣ እግዚአብሔርም ከሙታን ያስነሣው በናዝራዊው በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስም፣ በእርሱ ይህ ሰው ደኅና ሆኖ በፊታችሁ እንደ ቆመ ለሁላችሁና ለእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሁሉ የታወቀ ይሁን።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ ጴጥሮስ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተሞልቶ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «የሕዝብ መሪዎችና ሽማግሌዎች ሆይ፣ \v 9 ዛሬ አካለ ስንኩል ለሆነ ሰው ስለ ተደረገው መልካም ነገርና ሰውየው እንዴት እንደ ተፈወሰ የምትጠይቁን ከሆነ፣ \v 10 እናንተ ሁላችሁና መላው የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ይህን ልታውቁ ይገባል፤ ይህ የተደረገው እናንተ በሰቀላችሁት፣ እግዚአብሔር ግን ከሙታን ባስነሣው በናዝሬቱ በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስም ነው። ይህ ሰው ጤነኛና ሙሉ ሆኖ በፊታችሁ የቆመው በእርሱ ነው።
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ጴጥሮስን ሞላው፤ እርሱም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እናንተ የሕዝቡ መሪዎችና ሽማግሌዎች፣ \v 9 ዛሬ መራመድ ለማይችል ሰው ስላደረግነው መልካም ነገር ትጠይቁናላችሁ። ይህ ሰው እንዴት እንደ ተፈወሰ ማወቅ ትፈልጋላችሁ። \v 10 እናንተ ሁላችሁና የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሁሉ ይህን ማወቅ አለባችሁ፦ ይህ ሰው የተፈወሰው ከናዝሬት በሆነው በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ኃይል ነው። እናንተ በመስቀል ላይ ቸነከራችሁት፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ከሞት አስነሣው። ይህ ሰው ሙሉ በሙሉ ድኖ በፊታችሁ የቆመው በኢየሱስ ምክንያት ነው።

hi.L: तब पतरस ने पवित्र आत्मा से भरकर उनसे कहा, "हे लोगों के सरदारो और पुरनियो, \v 9 यदि आज हमसे एक बीमार मनुष्य के साथ की गई भलाई के विषय में पूछताछ की जाती है, कि यह किसके द्वारा चंगा हुआ, \v 10 तो आप सब और इस्राएल के सब लोग जान लें कि यीशु मसीह नासरी के नाम से, जिन्हें आपने क्रूस पर चढ़ाया, जिन्हें परमेश्वर ने मरे हुओं में से जिलाया, उन्हीं के द्वारा यह मनुष्य आपके सामने भला-चंगा खड़ा है।
hi.B: तब पतरस ने पवित्र आत्मा से भरकर उनसे कहा, "हे लोगों के सरदारो और बुज़ुर्ग अगुवो, \v 9 जब आज हमसे एक लाचार आदमी के साथ की गई भलाई के बारे में पूछताछ हो रही है, और यह पूछा जा रहा है कि वह कैसे ठीक हुआ, \v 10 तो आप सब और इस्राएल के सारे लोग यह बात समझ लें: यह नासरत के यीशु मसीह के नाम से हुआ है, जिन्हें आपने क्रूस पर चढ़ाया और जिन्हें परमेश्वर ने मरे हुओं में से जिला उठाया। उन्हीं के द्वारा यह आदमी आपके सामने भला-चंगा खड़ा है।
hi.R: तब पवित्र आत्मा ने पतरस को भर दिया, और उसने उनसे कहा, "हे लोगों के सरदारो और बुज़ुर्ग अगुवो, \v 9 आज आप हमसे उस भले काम के बारे में पूछ रहे हैं जो हमने एक ऐसे आदमी के लिए किया जो चल नहीं सकता था। आप जानना चाहते हैं कि वह कैसे ठीक हुआ। \v 10 आप सबको और इस्राएल के सब लोगों को यह जान लेना चाहिए। यह आदमी नासरत के यीशु मसीह की सामर्थ्य से ठीक हुआ है। आपने उन्हें क्रूस पर कीलों से ठुकवाया, पर परमेश्वर ने उन्हें फिर से जीवित कर दिया। यीशु के कारण ही यह आदमी पूरी तरह ठीक होकर यहाँ आपके सामने खड़ा है।

ru.L: Тогда Пётр, исполнившись Святого Духа, сказал им: «Начальники народа и старейшины, \v 9 если нас сегодня допрашивают о добром деле, [сделанном] немощному человеку, — чем он спасён, — \v 10 да будет известно всем вам и всему народу Израиля, что именем Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} Назорея, которого вы распяли, которого Бог воскресил из мёртвых, — в {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} этот [человек] стоит перед вами здоровым.
ru.B: Тогда Пётр, исполненный Святого Духа, сказал им: «Начальники народа и старейшины! \v 9 Раз нас сегодня допрашивают о добром деле, сделанном для больного человека, и о том, как он исцелился, \v 10 то пусть все вы и весь народ Израиля знаете вот что. Это сделано во имя Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} из Назарета, которого вы распяли и которого Бог воскресил из мёртвых. Благодаря {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} этот человек стоит перед вами здоровым.
ru.R: Тогда Святой Дух наполнил Петра, и он сказал им: «Начальники и старейшины народа! \v 9 Сегодня вы спрашиваете нас о добром деле, которое мы сделали для человека, который не мог ходить. Вы хотите знать, как он исцелился. \v 10 Все вы и весь народ Израиля должны знать: этот человек исцелён силой Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} из Назарета. Вы прибили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} к кресту, но Бог вернул {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} к жизни. Благодаря Иисусу этот человек стоит здесь перед вами совсем здоровым.

uk.L: Тоді Петро, сповнений Святого Духа, сказав їм: «Правителі народу і старійшини, \v 9 якщо нас сьогодні допитують про добре діло [вчинене] немічній людині, чим цей [чоловік] був спасений, \v 10 нехай буде відомо всім вам і всьому народові Ізраїлю, що в імʼя Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месії}} Назорея, якого ви розіпʼяли, якого Бог воскресив із мертвих, — ним цей [чоловік] стоїть перед вами здоровий.
uk.B: Тоді Петро, сповнений Святого Духа, сказав їм: «Провідники народу і старійшини! \v 9 Оскільки сьогодні нас допитують про добре діло, зроблене для немічної людини, і про те, як вона видужала, \v 10 то нехай усі ви й увесь народ Ізраїлю знаєте це. Це сталося в імʼя Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месії}} з Назарета, якого ви розіпʼяли і якого Бог воскресив із мертвих. Через {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} цей чоловік стоїть перед вами цілий і здоровий.
uk.R: Тоді Святий Дух сповнив Петра, і він сказав їм: «Провідники і старійшини народу! \v 9 Сьогодні ви питаєте нас про добро, яке ми зробили для чоловіка, що не міг ходити. Ви хочете знати, як він видужав. \v 10 Усі ви і весь народ Ізраїлю мусите знати ось що. Цього чоловіка зцілила сила Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месії}} з Назарета. Ви прибили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} до хреста, але Бог повернув {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} до життя. Завдяки Ісусові цей чоловік стоїть тут перед вами цілком здоровий.

ja.L: そのとき、ペトロは聖霊に満たされて彼らに言った。「民の指導者の方々、また長老の方々、\v 9 もしわたしたちが今日、病人になされた善い行いについて、この人が何によって救われたのかと取り調べを受けているのであれば、\v 10 あなたがた皆も、イスラエルの民全体も、知っておいてください。あなたがたが十字架につけ、神が死者の中から起こされたナザレ人イエス・{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の名によって、この方によって、この人は健やかになってあなたがたの前に立っているのです。
ja.B: そのとき、ペトロは聖霊に満たされて、彼らに言った。「民の指導者の方々、長老の方々、\v 9 わたしたちが今日取り調べを受けているのは、体の不自由な人にした親切な行いのこと、またその人がどのようにして治ったのかということなのですから、\v 10 あなたがたも皆、またイスラエルの民全体も、このことをしっかり知っておいてください。これはナザレのイエス・{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の名によってなされたのです。あなたがたはこの方を十字架につけましたが、神はこの方を死者の中から復活させられました。この方によって、この人は健やかな体であなたがたの前に立っているのです。
ja.R: そのとき、聖霊がペトロを満たされました。ペトロは彼らに言いました。「民の指導者と長老のみなさん、\v 9 今日、みなさんは、わたしたちが歩けない人にした良いことについて尋ねています。この人がどうやって治ったのかを知りたいのですね。\v 10 みなさんも、イスラエルの人々も皆、このことを知ってください。この人は、ナザレから来たイエス・{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の力によって治ったのです。みなさんはこの方を十字架につけました。しかし神は、この方をよみがえらせられました。このイエスのおかげで、この人はすっかりよくなって、ここにみなさんの前に立っているのです。

decisions.choice: filled with the Holy Spirit: given the Spirit's power for this moment
decisions.reason: Jesus promised that when his followers were brought before rulers, the Holy Spirit would teach them what to say (Luke 12:11-12, 21:12-15). The verb looks at a filling for the task at hand.

decisions.choice: if: since, as is in fact the case
decisions.reason: The condition is stated as true: they are being examined.

decisions.choice: has been made well: healed, and also saved
decisions.reason: The verb means to save or to make well. Peter uses the healing to lead to the salvation that comes only through Jesus (4:12).

decisions.choice: in this one: by Jesus, or by this name
decisions.reason: The word can refer to Jesus or to his name. The meaning hardly differs, since the name stands for the person. Literal keeps the open form.

decisions.choice: in the name of Jesus: by his authority and power
decisions.reason: As at 3:6 and 3:16.

decisions.choice: since
decisions.reason: Balanced shows that the condition is true, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: by the power of
decisions.reason: As at 3:6, Readable says what the name means here.

decisions.choice: a été guéri
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for being saved (m3), but in French "sauvé" said of a lame man would not suggest healing at all; "guéri" gives the sense the context requires, and 4:12 then speaks of being saved with the related noun.

decisions.choice: ameponywa
decisions.reason: The Greek verb means both to be made well and to be saved (meaning decision on "has been made well"). Swahili has no one word for both: "kuokolewa" would not be understood of a lame man's healing, so every level says "ameponywa", and the link with "wokovu" and "kuokolewa" in verse 12 is left to the decision.

decisions.choice: por este
decisions.reason: "In this one" may be Jesus or his name (meaning decision, footnoted); Spanish "este" can point back to either, so Literal keeps the open reading.

decisions.choice: "Thưa các nhà cầm quyền ... và các trưởng lão" (L), and "các ông" for "you", with "chúng tôi" for Peter and John
decisions.reason: Peter speaks with respect to the rulers of his people but without bowing to them; "các ông" is respectful and plain. The same forms are kept when the apostles and Stephen speak to the council (5:29-32; 7:2-53).

decisions.choice: "được cứu" (L); "được lành" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means healed, and also saved (meaning decision); Literal keeps "cứu", which prepares for "sự cứu rỗi" in 4:12.

decisions.choice: Peter speaks to the council in 합쇼체, with "백성의 지도자들과 장로 여러분" and "우리"
decisions.reason: Speaking to the rulers, Peter uses the formal polite style; he speaks boldly (4:13), so he says "우리" rather than the humble "저희", as the apostles speak through Acts.

decisions.choice: "구원받았는지" (L), "낫게 되었는지" (B, R) for sesōstai
decisions.reason: The verb means both healed and saved (meaning decision); Literal keeps the word that holds both, which comes back in 4:12, and Balanced and Readable say what happened to the man.

decisions.choice: os senhores
decisions.reason: For the whole book: speakers address the council and other officials with "o senhor / os senhores", as Brazilians address those in authority (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4); "vocês" would sound rude before the high priest. Peter's boldness is in what he says, not in his form of address.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun or christos spans
alternatives: capitalised pronouns; "ख्रीष्ट" with "मसीह" as the alternative
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change, and "मसीह" is already both the title and the word Messiah, so Hindi has no christos setting (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: Peter says "आप" to the council
decisions.reason: The style guide's address to rulers (section 4), and the apostles' address to any assembly in Acts.

decisions.choice: спасён
decisions.reason: The verb means both "made well" and "saved" (meaning decision); Literal keeps "спасён", which carries both, Balanced and Readable say "исцелился".

decisions.choice: "ним" with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Ukrainian "ним" can point to the name (neuter) or to Jesus (masculine), which keeps the Greek open, as the meaning decision says; a capital would decide it.

decisions.choice: Peter speaks to the council in です・ます
decisions.reason: As in the shared Acts terms, the apostles address crowds and councils politely at every level; the rulers are addressed as "方々" (L, B) and "みなさん" (R).

decisions.choice: "起こされた" (L); "復活させられた" (B); "よみがえらせられた" (R)
decisions.reason: The shared Acts terms for God's raising of Jesus, with the light honorific for God's act.

source.text: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ λίθος ὁ ἐξουθενηθεὶς ὑφ’ ὑμῶν τῶν οἰκοδόμων, ὁ γενόμενος εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας.

records.literal_gloss: This is the stone the having been despised by you the builders, the having become into head of corner.

en.L: This [one] is the stone that was despised by you, the builders, which has become [the] head of [the] corner.
en.B: He is the stone that you builders scorned as worthless, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has become the head of the corner.
en.R: Jesus is like the stone that the builders threw away as useless. But that stone has now become the most important stone in the building.

fr.L: Celui-ci est la pierre méprisée par vous, les bâtisseurs, qui est devenue tête d’angle.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, la pierre que vous, les bâtisseurs, avez traitée comme sans valeur, et c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui est devenu la tête de l’angle.
fr.R: Jésus est comme la pierre que les bâtisseurs ont jetée parce qu’ils la croyaient inutile. Mais maintenant, cette pierre est devenue la pierre la plus importante du bâtiment.

sw.L: Huyu ndiye lile jiwe lililodharauliwa nanyi wajenzi, ambalo limekuwa kichwa cha pembe.
sw.B: Yeye ndiye jiwe ambalo ninyi wajenzi mlilidharau kuwa halifai, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} amekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni.
sw.R: Yesu ni kama lile jiwe ambalo wajenzi walilitupa kuwa halifai. Lakini sasa jiwe hilo limekuwa jiwe muhimu kuliko yote katika jengo.

es.L: Este es la piedra despreciada por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los constructores, que ha llegado a ser cabeza del ángulo.
es.B: Él es la piedra que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los constructores, {{plural_you:despreciaron|despreciasteis}} como algo sin valor, y que ha llegado a ser la piedra angular principal.
es.R: Jesús es como la piedra que los constructores tiraron porque no servía. Pero ahora esa piedra es la más importante del edificio.

vi.L: Đấng này là hòn đá đã bị các ông, là những thợ xây, khinh bỏ, mà đã trở thành đầu góc nhà.
vi.B: Ngài là hòn đá bị các ông là thợ xây loại bỏ như vô dụng, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở thành tảng đá góc nhà quan trọng nhất.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu giống như hòn đá mà thợ xây không muốn dùng. Nhưng hòn đá ấy đã trở thành hòn đá quan trọng nhất của ngôi nhà.

ko.L: 이분은 집 짓는 사람들인 여러분에게 업신여김을 받았으나 모퉁이의 머리가 된 그 돌입니다.
ko.B: 이분은 집 짓는 사람들인 여러분이 쓸모없다고 버렸으나, 모퉁이를 받치는 으뜸 돌이 되신 그 돌입니다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 집 짓는 사람들이 필요 없다고 버린 돌과 같습니다. 그러나 그 돌이 이제 건물에서 가장 중요한 돌이 되었습니다.

pt.L: Este é a pedra que foi desprezada pelos senhores, os construtores, a qual se tornou cabeça de esquina.
pt.B: Ele é a pedra que os senhores, os construtores, desprezaram como sem valor, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se tornou a pedra principal da esquina.
pt.R: Jesus é como a pedra que os construtores jogaram fora como inútil. Mas essa pedra agora se tornou a pedra mais importante do edifício.

am.L: እርሱ እናንተ ግንበኞች የናቃችሁት፣ የማዕዘን ራስ የሆነው ድንጋይ ነው።
am.B: እርሱ እናንተ ግንበኞች እንደ ከንቱ የናቃችሁት ድንጋይ ነው፤ እርሱም የማዕዘን ራስ ሆኗል።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ግንበኞች የማይጠቅም ብለው እንደ ጣሉት ድንጋይ ነው። ያ ድንጋይ ግን አሁን በሕንጻው ውስጥ ከሁሉ የሚበልጥ አስፈላጊ ድንጋይ ሆኗል።

hi.L: यही वह पत्थर हैं जिसे आप बनानेवालों ने तुच्छ जाना, और जो कोने का मुख्य [पत्थर] बन गया।
hi.B: वे वही पत्थर हैं जिसे आप राजमिस्त्रियों ने निकम्मा समझकर ठुकरा दिया, और वही कोने का मुख्य पत्थर बन गया है।
hi.R: यीशु उस पत्थर के जैसे हैं जिसे बनानेवालों ने बेकार समझकर फेंक दिया। पर अब वही पत्थर इमारत का सबसे ज़रूरी पत्थर बन गया है।

ru.L: Это камень, пренебрежённый вами, строителями, который стал главою угла.
ru.B: Он — тот камень, который вы, строители, отвергли как негодный, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} стал краеугольным камнем.
ru.R: Иисус похож на камень, который строители выбросили как ненужный. Но этот камень стал теперь самым главным камнем в здании.

uk.L: Цей — камінь, знехтуваний вами, будівничими, що став головою кута.
uk.B: Він — той камінь, яким ви, будівничі, погордували як нікчемним, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} став наріжним каменем.
uk.R: Ісус — наче камінь, який будівельники викинули як непотрібний. Але тепер цей камінь став найважливішим каменем у будові.

ja.L: この方は、家を建てる者であるあなたがたに軽んじられた石、隅の頭となった石です。
ja.B: この方こそ、家を建てるあなたがたが値打ちのないものとさげすんだ石であり、建物の隅を支えるかなめの石となった方です。
ja.R: イエスは、家を建てる人たちが役に立たないと捨てた石のような方です。けれども、その石が今では、建物でいちばん大切な石になったのです。

decisions.choice: the rejected stone: Psalm 118:22
decisions.reason: Peter takes the words of Psalm 118:22 and applies them to his hearers: "you, the builders". Jesus used the same verse of himself (Luke 20:17). Because Peter changes the wording, it is not set off as a quotation.

decisions.choice: despised: treated as worth nothing
decisions.reason: Peter uses a stronger word than the psalm's "rejected": the builders held the stone in contempt.

decisions.choice: head of the corner: the stone that holds the building together
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean the main cornerstone of the foundation or the top stone that completes an arch or wall. Either way it is the most important stone.

decisions.choice: Jesus is like the stone
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus and marks the picture as a comparison.

decisions.choice: kichwa cha pembe (L); jiwe kuu la pembeni (B)
alternatives: jiwe la pembeni at every level
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:10, which quotes the same psalm (meaning decision on head of the corner): Literal keeps the Greek picture, Balanced names the stone.

decisions.choice: cabeza del ángulo (L); piedra angular principal (B)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:10, the same Psalm 118:22: the stone that holds the building together (meaning decision on the head of the corner).

decisions.choice: Psalm 118:22 worded as in the Vietnamese Luke 20:17 and Mark 12:10: "đầu góc nhà" (L), "tảng đá góc nhà quan trọng nhất" (B), "hòn đá quan trọng nhất của ngôi nhà" (R)
decisions.reason: Peter turns the psalm on his hearers ("you, the builders"), so the verb is "khinh bỏ" at Literal for "despised"; the rest keeps the wording readers know from the Gospels.

decisions.choice: the wording of the Korean Luke 20:17 for Psalm 118:22, with "여러분" for "you builders"
decisions.reason: Luke quotes the same psalm in both volumes; the Korean keeps them alike, as the batch brief asks. Here Peter turns it on his hearers, so "여러분" is added as the Greek has it.

decisions.choice: "तुच्छ जाना" (L); "कोने का मुख्य पत्थर", "राजमिस्त्री" (B)
alternatives: "ठुकरा दिया" at Literal, as in Luke 20:17
decisions.reason: The psalm verse is the one Jesus quotes in Luke 20:17, and the Hindi keeps its words for the stone and the builders. Peter uses another verb, "treated as nothing" (meaning decision m2), so Literal differs there.

decisions.choice: главою угла (L); краеугольным камнем (B)
decisions.reason: The words of Psalm 118:22, worded as in Luke 20:17: Literal keeps the Greek phrase, Balanced says "краеугольный камень".

decisions.choice: "головою кута" (L), "наріжним каменем" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture; Balanced uses the Ukrainian building term for the stone that holds the corner.

decisions.choice: "建物の隅を支えるかなめの石"
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the head of the corner is, the stone that holds the building together (m3); Literal keeps "隅の頭".

source.text: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἄλλῳ οὐδενὶ ἡ σωτηρία, οὐδὲ γὰρ ὄνομά ἐστιν ἕτερον ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανὸν τὸ δεδομένον ἐν ἀνθρώποις ἐν ᾧ δεῖ σωθῆναι ἡμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: And not there is in other no one the salvation, not for name is another under the heaven the having been given among men in which it is necessary to be saved us.

en.L: And there is salvation in no one else, for neither is there another name under heaven that has been given among {{gender:people|men}} by which we must be saved."
en.B: Salvation comes through no one but {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Under all of heaven God has given humankind no other name through which we are to be saved."
en.R: Only Jesus can bring salvation. In the whole world God has not given us anyone else who can save us. We must be saved by {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

fr.L: Et le salut n’est en nul autre, car il n’existe pas non plus, sous le ciel, d’autre nom qui ait été donné parmi {{gender:les humains|les hommes}} et dans lequel nous devons être sauvés. »
fr.B: Le salut ne vient par personne d’autre que {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Sous le ciel entier, Dieu n’a donné à l’humanité aucun autre nom par lequel il nous faut être sauvés. »
fr.R: Seul Jésus peut apporter le salut. Dans le monde entier, Dieu ne nous a donné personne d’autre qui puisse nous sauver. C’est par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que nous devons être sauvés. »

sw.L: Na wokovu haupatikani kwa mwingine yeyote, kwa maana hakuna jina lingine chini ya mbingu lililotolewa miongoni mwa wanadamu ambalo kwa hilo ni lazima sisi tuokolewe."
sw.B: Wokovu haupatikani kwa mwingine yeyote ila {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}. Chini ya mbingu zote Mungu hajawapa wanadamu jina lingine ambalo kwalo tunapaswa kuokolewa."
sw.R: Ni Yesu peke yake anayeweza kuleta wokovu. Katika ulimwengu wote Mungu hajatupa mtu mwingine yeyote anayeweza kutuokoa. Ni lazima tuokolewe kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}."

es.L: Y en ningún otro hay salvación, porque no hay otro nombre bajo el cielo dado entre {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} en el cual debamos ser salvos».
es.B: La salvación no viene por medio de nadie más que de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Bajo el cielo, Dios no ha dado a la humanidad ningún otro nombre por el cual debamos ser salvos».
es.R: Solo Jesús puede traer la salvación. En todo el mundo, Dios no nos ha dado a nadie más que pueda salvarnos. Tenemos que ser salvados por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».

vi.L: Và không có sự cứu rỗi trong một ai khác, vì dưới trời không có danh nào khác được ban cho loài người, để nhờ đó chúng ta phải được cứu."
vi.B: Không có sự cứu rỗi nơi một ai khác ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Dưới cả bầu trời này, Đức Chúa Trời không ban cho loài người một danh nào khác để nhờ đó chúng ta được cứu."
vi.R: Chỉ có Đức Giê-xu mới đem lại sự cứu rỗi. Trên khắp thế giới, Đức Chúa Trời không ban cho chúng ta một ai khác có thể cứu chúng ta. Chúng ta phải được cứu bởi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."

ko.L: 그리고 다른 누구에게도 구원이 없습니다. 하늘 아래에서 사람들에게 주신 이름 가운데, 우리가 구원을 받아야 할 다른 이름은 없기 때문입니다."
ko.B: 이분 말고는 다른 누구에게서도 구원을 받을 수 없습니다. 하나님께서는 하늘 아래 사람들에게 우리가 구원을 받을 다른 이름을 주신 적이 없습니다."
ko.R: 오직 예수만이 구원을 주실 수 있습니다. 하나님께서는 온 세상에서 우리를 구원할 다른 누구도 우리에게 주지 않으셨습니다. 우리는 예수를 통하여 구원을 받아야 합니다."

pt.L: E não há salvação em nenhum outro, pois também não há debaixo do céu outro nome dado entre {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} pelo qual devamos ser salvos."
pt.B: Não há salvação por meio de ninguém mais, a não ser por meio {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Debaixo de todo o céu, Deus não deu à humanidade nenhum outro nome pelo qual devamos ser salvos."
pt.R: Só Jesus pode trazer a salvação. No mundo inteiro, Deus não deu a nós nenhuma outra pessoa que possa nos salvar. Nós precisamos ser salvos por {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}."

am.L: መዳንም በሌላ በማንም የለም፤ የምንድንበት ከሰማይ በታች በሰዎች መካከል የተሰጠ ሌላ ስም የለምና።»
am.B: መዳን ከእርሱ በቀር በማንም አይገኝም። እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ በታች ለሰው ልጆች ልንድንበት የሚገባ ሌላ ስም አልሰጠም።»
am.R: መዳንን ሊያመጣ የሚችል ኢየሱስ ብቻ ነው። በዓለም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ሊያድነን የሚችል ሌላ ማንንም አልሰጠንም። መዳን ያለብን በእርሱ ነው።»

hi.L: और किसी दूसरे में उद्धार नहीं, क्योंकि स्वर्ग के नीचे मनुष्यों में कोई दूसरा नाम नहीं दिया गया, जिसके द्वारा हमें उद्धार पाना अवश्य है।"
hi.B: उद्धार उनके सिवा किसी और के द्वारा नहीं मिलता। सारे आकाश के नीचे परमेश्वर ने मनुष्यों को कोई और नाम नहीं दिया जिसके द्वारा हमें उद्धार पाना है।"
hi.R: केवल यीशु ही उद्धार दे सकते हैं। सारे संसार में परमेश्वर ने हमें कोई और नहीं दिया जो हमें बचा सके। हमें उन्हीं के द्वारा उद्धार पाना है।"

ru.L: И нет ни в ком другом спасения, ведь нет под небом другого имени, данного среди людей, которым нам надлежит спастись.»
ru.B: Спасение — только через {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}. Во всём поднебесном мире Бог не дал людям другого имени, которым нам нужно спастись.»
ru.R: Только Иисус может спасти. Во всём мире Бог не дал нам никого другого, кто может нас спасти. Мы должны быть спасены через {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}.»

uk.L: І нема спасіння ні в кому іншому, бо нема під небом іншого імені, даного між людьми, яким нам належить спастися.»
uk.B: Спасіння немає ні в кому, крім {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}. Під усім небом Бог не дав людям іншого імені, через яке ми маємо бути спасені.»
uk.R: Тільки Ісус може врятувати. У всьому світі Бог не дав нам нікого іншого, хто міг би нас врятувати. Ми маємо бути врятовані через {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}.»

ja.L: そして、ほかのだれによっても救いはありません。天の下で、人々の間に与えられた名で、わたしたちが救われるべき名は、ほかにないからです。」
ja.B: この方以外のだれによっても、救いは得られません。天の下のどこにも、わたしたちが救われるべき名として神が人々にお与えになった名は、ほかにないのです。」
ja.R: イエスだけが、救いをもたらすことがおできになります。神は世界中のどこにも、わたしたちを救うことのできる方を、ほかにお与えになりませんでした。わたしたちはイエスによって救われなければならないのです。」

decisions.choice: salvation: rescue from sin and death, the whole of what God saves people for
decisions.reason: The man's healing ("made well", 4:9) is a sign of a greater salvation that comes only through Jesus (2:21, 2:40).

decisions.choice: name: the person who bears it
decisions.reason: As in 4:10, the name stands for Jesus himself.

decisions.choice: under heaven: anywhere in the world
decisions.reason: The phrase means everywhere people live (2:5).

decisions.choice: we must be saved: it is God's will that salvation come this way
alternatives: we are forced to be saved
decisions.reason: The word for "must" often expresses God's plan in Luke's writings (Luke 24:26; Acts 1:16, 3:21).

decisions.choice: men: human beings
decisions.reason: The word means people in general.

decisions.choice: God has given
decisions.reason: The passive means that God gave the name; Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: people, with "men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The word means human beings, men and women.

decisions.choice: wanadamu, with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span like the English people / men
decisions.reason: "Wanadamu" (human beings) is the plain Swahili for the Greek word here (meaning decision on men); the only alternative, "wanaume", means males and would change the meaning, so there is no second wording for the gender setting.

decisions.choice: {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}
decisions.reason: Human beings (meaning decision on men); the inclusive form is the default and the traditional "los hombres" the alternative.

decisions.choice: "sự cứu rỗi" for salvation at every level; "loài người" for "men", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "sự cứu rỗi" is the Protestant word of the Vietnamese Luke. "loài người" means humankind, so the setting the English needs at Literal has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "사람들" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Men here means human beings (meaning decision); Korean "사람" says that already, so the English Literal span has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "በሰዎች መካከል" (among people), no gender span
decisions.reason: "ሰዎች" means human beings, men and women, so the inclusive sense the English Literal gives with its setting is already in the Amharic word.

decisions.choice: "मनुष्यों", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Hindi "मनुष्य" means human beings, men and women (meaning decision m5), so the English gender span has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: среди людей (no setting)
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span at Literal. Russian "люди" already means human beings, men and women, so no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: "між людьми" with no gender setting
alternatives: a gender span as in the English "people/men"
decisions.reason: The Greek here is anthrōpoi, human beings, and Ukrainian "люди" already says that.

decisions.choice: "人々", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span on this word for human beings (m5). Japanese "人々" already includes men and women, so it needs no span; the same holds wherever this word means people in general in these chapters.

source.text: Θεωροῦντες δὲ τὴν τοῦ Πέτρου παρρησίαν καὶ Ἰωάννου καὶ καταλαβόμενοι ὅτι ἄνθρωποι ἀγράμματοί εἰσιν καὶ ἰδιῶται, ἐθαύμαζον, ἐπεγίνωσκόν τε αὐτοὺς ὅτι σὺν τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἦσαν, τόν τε ἄνθρωπον βλέποντες σὺν αὐτοῖς ἑστῶτα τὸν τεθεραπευμένον οὐδὲν εἶχον ἀντειπεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Seeing now the of the Peter boldness and of John, and having perceived that men unlettered they are and untrained, they were marveling, they were recognizing and them that with the Jesus they had been; \v 14 the and man seeing with them standing, the having been healed, nothing they had to say against.

en.L: Now seeing the boldness of Peter and John, and having perceived that they were unlettered and untrained men, they were amazed, and they recognized them, that they had been with Jesus. \v 14 And seeing the man who had been healed standing with them, they had nothing to say against [it].
en.B: The council members saw how freely Peter and John spoke, and they realized these were men without formal schooling, just ordinary people. This astonished them, and they recognized that the two had been companions of Jesus. \v 14 But with the healed man standing right there beside them, they could say nothing to refute it.
